body:
GREG, 2026-11-07, relayed by Engram::Asistant (mailbox 43498a6e). Verbatim:
- #487 (00:54Z, URGENT): „USUNAC TESTY sprawdzajace claud.md czy agents.md Natychmiast!! Nigdy ich niedodawac”.
- #490 (00:57Z): „Zero tautologi. Tak marnujemy cykle. Te testy nic nie wnosza. Teraz kazda zmiana wymusza zmiane testow. Czyli edycja 2 razy. O ile zlapiemy to odrazu. Absurd! Nigdy wiecej.”
- #495 (01:06Z, URGENT): „Nie ma testów czytających pliki md i sprawdzania czy mają okreslone frazy. Usunąć natychmiast.”
Asistant's scope notes (interpretation, not Greg's verbatim words):
- #489: also covers the automatic AGENTS/CLAUDE byte-identity gate.
- #490: no test that only pins text or mirrors the implementation and forces a double edit; test observable behavior where needed; no automatic wording gates.
- #493 and #495: ALL Markdown files; delete every test that reads .md and asserts phrases, with no equivalent replacement and no long review; keep checks of real product behavior.
RULE FOR EVERY AGENT: never add such tests or checks, and flag them in review. check-doc-links.mjs (link resolution) is not such a test.
Execution:
- w-a577d36eba5c (Merger): bans instruction-content tests and tautology tests, removes the identity gate; governed text, audit nearly done.
- w-b4c3c4136a38 (12325): deletes Engram's .md phrase tests (refusal_tests.rs, backup_status_receipt_cli.rs table check, named_root/read.rs doc check, and others) and adds the #495 ban sentence.
- TermAl: w-7dafeeae3cfe (Opus3).
